Thank you for taking the time to share your experience. We are very sorry to hear how unwell your daughter was and hope that she has since made a full recovery. We understand how distressing it must have been for you both to be passed between services when you needed urgent care and support.

We’re truly sorry that things were so difficult. Unfortunately, on the day you contacted us, we had already reached full capacity and were unable to safely see any further patients. At that stage, our clinical team was directing patients to NHS 111 or GP out-of-hours services, in line with our protocol for when our urgent slots are full.

It is unclear from the records why your daughter was subsequently directed to A&E. We agree this sounds like a case that ideally could have been managed in primary care, and we share your concern about the strain this puts on emergency departments. While we are not responsible for decisions made by NHS 111, we understand how frustrating it can be to be redirected between services. NHS 111 operates under its own clinical and complaints procedures, and we would encourage you to feed back directly if you feel their input contributed to the delay in your daughter receiving the care she needed.

We recognise how upsetting this experience must have been, especially if it’s not the first time you’ve felt let down by our service. Please be assured that ensuring urgent, same-day care for patients who need it is one of our highest priorities. Regrettably, like many practices, we are working within a system where demand for care regularly exceeds the resources we are funded to provide. We are doing all we can within these constraints to avoid turning patients away, and we very much hope that new funding announced by the Department of Health will improve access in the months ahead.

Of course, you have every right to seek care from another practice, but we are sorry to lose your trust and saddened that you feel our team lacks care or empathy. That is far from our intention, and we are always open to feedback that helps us improve. Our complaints procedure is on our website here, should you wish to take this further: https://www.foresthealthgroup.co.uk/practice-information/

Thank you again for taking the time to raise your concerns. We hope your daughter continues to recover well and we wish you and your family all the best, whatever decision you make going forward.

Best wishes,
Dr R Boyce (GP Partner; Forest Health Group)",null,[0,177]]]],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tOcU0zSlZRbWxvZUdOc0xWQjRVazB6VVRSWWFtYxAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x3a8aba63e9fa7267!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOkNqM3JVQmloeGNsLVB4Uk0zUTRYamc%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tOcU0zSlZRbWxvZUdOc0xWQjRVazB6VVRSWWFtYxAB&t=1&-uljuoo6KgswY0pMOEFLdUlMag&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwiq1MvngLaTAxXwR4QGHTR-CZkQoykIECgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwiq1MvngLaTAxXwR4QGHTR-CZkQ0pMFCA4oBA"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFEeHBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMmxEUjBGdFdWOWZSV2hDZUMweFdUaEJVMGx4T0dsQ2NYUkJVVUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpxUlVOaFNVbFpRMXBuV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VMdmNwSW16dUwyRHlBRRAB",["0x0:0x3a8aba63e9fa7267",null,1746715274771624,1746715274771624,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/108934591770418851548/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Mel Stew","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocKMn2nqHxFw-WSyBaxDwZki0IQ21z-lmogqusvEdbsXoXU60Q=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/108934591770418851548?hl=en"],"108934591770418851548",null,3,0,null,[0,2,1],0,["3 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwiq1MvngLaTAxXwR4QGHTR-CZkQ7LoGCBIoAA"]]]],null,"10 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[5],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["I had my routine screening with M Duria today and I have to say she made me feel very comfortable, I felt no discomfort whatsoever.
